IncidentBot: [ALERT] Elevated 502/504 errors observed at API gateway (edge tier). 5m error rate: 11%. P99 latency rising. Paging SRE-oncall.
Maya (SRE-oncall): I'm on it — checking dashboards & logs now. Any recent edge changes?
Jesse (eng-runtime): No runtime deploys in the last 30m. Infra pushed an edge-proxy config 12m ago (checksum 9a7f).
Sam (support): We're getting multiple customer reports, web UI failing with "502 Bad Gateway" during streaming. Tickets piling (approx 18).
Maya (SRE-oncall): Correlating logs -> spike aligns with that config push. Upstream failures show "connection reset by peer" and intermittent 504s for long poll.
Nadia (platform): rolling back that edge-proxy config now. Command: ```kubectl -n edge rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=157```
DeployBot: rollback started by Nadia at 2834500060 (edge/edge-proxy).
Maya (SRE-oncall): While rollback runs, let's reduce blast radius: temporary regional routing + scale proxies. Proposal: route 50% eu-central -> us-east-1 and bump edge-proxy replicas by +3.
Jesse (eng-runtime): Running routing command: ```sh shardctl route set --from eu-central --to us-east-1 --pct 50 --reason "502 mitigation"```
Maya (SRE-oncall): Scaling: ```kubectl -n edge scale deploy/edge-proxy --replicas=12``` (was 9).
Jesse (eng-runtime): Telemetry after routing 50%: global 502s dropped 11% -> 6% in 2m. Good signal.
Eli (product): Do we have customer impact numbers? SLO hit? Which endpoints most affected?
Maya (SRE-oncall): Impacting ~12% of total requests at peak. Hot endpoints: /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate (streaming path). Peak failures ~2.5k req/min. Region worst: eu-central. Affected customers: multiple, ACME shows high error rate. SLOs materially degraded for streaming (>=1min windows).
Sam (support): Notified ACME CS rep, flagged as potential Sev1 for them. Sending status note.
Nadia (platform): Rollback finished at 2834500200. Checking upstream health and probe success.
Maya (SRE-oncall): Post-rollback metrics: error rate fell further to ~2.1% global within 3m. After routing + scale + rollback combined, 5m error rate now 1.2%.
Jesse (eng-runtime): Adding a temporary circuit-breaker on long poll endpoints to protect upstream: ```edge-proxy config snippet:
route /v1/chat/stream {
  circuit_breaker { max_connections: 200; max_pending: 100 }
}```
Maya (SRE-oncall): Applying circuit-breaker now. Also enabling stricter per-tenant rate-limits for heavy tenants until we stabilize (ACME limited to 500 rps).
Eli (product): Timeline to mitigation & next steps?
Maya (SRE-oncall): Timeline: 0m alert -> 5m routing -> 8m scale -> 12m rollback -> 20m circuit-breaker/policy -> 30m errors down to acceptable range. Next: full postmortem, root cause attribution (suspect edge-proxy config change introduced aggressive connection reuse + upstream timeout misconfiguration), and permanent guardrails (preflight tests for edge config + canary policy).
Jesse (eng-runtime): Collected sample logs showing "upstream reset" and 502 traces. Saved to /var/logs/incidents/2834500000/ for postmortem.
Sam (support): Sent interim status update to affected accounts. CS will wait for postmortem before client-facing RCA.
Maya (SRE-oncall): Handoff: Aisha (SRE-night) will take watch for the next 6 hours. Leaving monitoring alerts and escalation playbook in the thread.
Aisha (SRE-night): acknowledged, will monitor dashboards and contact oncall-rotation if re-escalation needed. I'll also add per-tenant heatmap panels.
Eli (product): Assigning postmortem owners: Nadia, Maya, Jesse. Please include timestamps, mitigation steps, and root cause hypothesis. Add follow-ups for: canary policy, preflight validation, and tenant throttling automation.
Maya (SRE-oncall): Incident state -> MITIGATED (actively monitoring). Will convert to postmortem and tag Sev2. Please add any missing logs or notes here. :memo: :white_check_mark:
